rule_gaps: "Fragrance Free" in a product name derives facets.type=Fragrance (Matas Striber micellar water and scrub mask) - the rule needs a negative lookahead for "fragrance free"/"parfymefri"
"mousse"/"foam" derives facets.type=Hair care regardless of context, so face cleansing mousse and a lip+cheek mousse land in hair care
"Primer" in the Beauty vocabulary outranks the srcCat crumb "Maling og oppussing" - a paint primer (Jernia) is live as a Beauty product
scented candles and room sprays (srcCat leaf "Duftlys") inherit Beauty from the perfumery parent crumb "Parfyme"; the leaf should map to Home
the Kicks feed appends the shade/size label to the product title, so 53 of the 56 Kicks rows in this shard render it twice ("... 214 Play For Keeps 214 Play For Keeps")
notes: Category quality is high (Blivakker/Parfymeri breadcrumbs are clean); the real damage is cosmetic - 53 Kicks titles print the shade twice, 27 shade/size families sit unwired as separate top-level rows, and 136 of 300 rows (all Blivakker, a sampled shop) still have no product photo.
